affected_system: fixed-route public transit service and passenger connections
alternatives: protect minimum coverage before needs-based allocation of transit fleet, operator, and recovery capacity
adapt allocations using observed demand, uptake, and capacity for transit fleet, operator, and recovery capacity
pair equity-constrained block and spare allocation with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Trips, stops, vehicle observations, disruptions, and calendars share a versioned service day.
Passenger loads and transfer behavior are measured or represented as bounded assumptions.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain the current distribution rule for transit fleet, operator, and recovery capacity.

constraints.description: The transit reliability and passenger continuity allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: transit chief operating officer and service-planning director
decision_question: How should vehicles, operators, and spare capacity be assigned across routes and depots?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The transit reliability and passenger continuity allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
independence_key.decision_object: transit fleet, operator, and recovery capacity
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for transit fleet, operator, and recovery capacity passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.
independence_key.primary_outcome: passenger demand without scheduled reliable capacity

intended_claim: A versioned allocate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting transit fleet, operator, and recovery capacity, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: passenger demand without scheduled reliable capacity
distributional gap in passenger demand without scheduled reliable capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not describe a vehicle and operator assignment as delivered service.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for transit fleet, operator, and recovery capacity passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.

title: Allocate fleet, operators, and recovery capacity
transportability_risks: Fare policy, headways, fleet, labor rules, topology, and passenger behavior vary by operator.
Reliability metrics may not transfer between schedule-based and frequency-based service.
